title: Device twin — reported properties
description: DESCRIPTIVE, NOT NORMATIVE. Generated from firmware source at FW 1.8.0, which is the WORKING TREE and is not committed. The nearest commit is ac1fc74, which is a different firmware version - do not read x-commit as containing this behaviour. This is not a specification and not a proposal; it records what the device emits today. Plane: Device twin (NOT D2C telemetry). `required` lists only keys present in the minimal payload, i.e. those always emitted for this message type.

fw_version.description: Hub firmware version, from the build-time PROJECT_VER.

gateway_id.description: GW- prefixed hub identity. Same value as telemetry gateway.id, different key name.

short_id.description: Last 4 hex of the gateway id.

hub_name.description: User-assigned hub name. NOTE: telemetry omits gateway.name when empty; the twin always emits the key.

provisioned.description: Whether the hub has completed commissioning.

lora_sensor_count.description: How many LoRa sensors are commissioned.

ble_leak_sensor_count.description: How many BLE leak sensors are commissioned.

auto_close_enabled.description: Whether the hub will close the valve automatically on a leak.

trigger_mask.description: Bitmask of which leak sources may trigger auto-close. bit0=BLE, bit1=LoRa, bit2=valve flood.

uptime_s.description: Seconds since boot AT THE MOMENT THE TWIN WAS PATCHED. Only three triggers write the twin, so this can be arbitrarily stale — it is not a live value.

free_heap.description: Free heap in bytes. The ONLY hub diagnostic that exists on the twin and nowhere in telemetry.
